resources.string: Keep received unsent messages in chat

Optional, session-only retention of verified received messages. History-only is the default. Your own messages and messages with unresolved ownership are removed normally. Retained messages are not restored after restarting Instagram.

Enable Hide Specific Chats or Keep Unsent Messages to use these actions.
Unassigned legacy entries are preserved. They are not applied to any account. Open each intended conversation and hide it again to associate it safely.

Long-press the conversation title, then choose Hide this chat. If unavailable, enable Show Hide Chat button and return to the chat. Current chat actions works only while that chat stays open behind these settings. Both header buttons are off by default and controlled independently. Hiding only filters supported inbox lists; search, notifications, sharing suggestions and direct entry may still expose chats.
Choose a frame with the slider. Only the full-resolution PNG is saved; the temporary video is removed when you save or close.
